newsitem.title: USA: Travelers/Aetna Property Casualty Corp Q3.
newsitem.headline: Travelers/Aetna Property Casualty Corp Q3.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTES: Aetna included from April 2, 1996, acquisition.

Net includes realized gains $900,000, or nil per share vs $22.7 million, or $0.07/shr, in quarter; and loss $20.1 million, or $0.06/shr, vs gain $22.9 million, or $0.07/shr, in nine months. This left operating income of $246.1 million vs $87.2 million in quarter and $148.9 million vs $261.2 million in nine months.
1996 nine months net also includes charges totaling $391.0 million, or $1.10 per share.
1996 nine months per share after preferred dividends of $3.5 million.
1996 third quarter contribution to Travelers Group Inc net was $201.8 million after minority interests of $44.3 million.
